ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 55% low-intensity dark pixels in the central and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on both left and right lobes; left lobe shows a dense white area with dark speckling along the superior margin; right lobe features a white patch with a distinct dark diagonal linear mark in the lower-medial quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate 90-degree internal angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge, exhibiting more pronounced jaggedness at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the inferior edges, sweeping symmetrically upwards from the peduncle toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Fine, high-intensity white speckling (circular pixel clusters) distributed densely across the dark central peduncle and the medial fluke transition zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single dark linear pixel disruption visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally within the white pigmented zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Asymmetrical jagged morphology and pixel-level erosion at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe compared to the right.
other_distinctive_markers: Salt-and-pepper pixel distribution concentrated at the junction of the fluke and the peduncle.
